title: 밥솥 버튼과 화면 읽기: 무엇을 눌러요?
objective: By the end, you can find the right button on a Korean rice cooker and read its screen to see the rice type, the time left, and whether it is cooking, keeping warm, or set for later.
summary: Learners read the buttons and screen of a Korean electric rice cooker to cook rice and check its status.
note: Button names change a little by brand, and the screens on this sheet are examples.

task.title: Read the rice cooker
task.line: Use the buttons and the screen words on this sheet to answer each question.

items.text: Press it to start cooking the rice.
items.example: 쌀하고 물을 넣었어요? 이제 취사를 누르세요.

items.text: Press it to stop what the cooker is doing.
Set it so the rice is ready at a later time.
This menu is for plain white rice.
This menu is for rice with beans or other grains.
This menu is for brown rice, and it takes longer.
This menu makes soft rice porridge.
The screen shows how many minutes are left until the rice is done.

steps.en: add water up to the line in the pot
stir the rice when it is done

sections.heading: Reading the screen
paragraphs: The menu name comes first, and then the state. 중 means "in progress". [백미] 취사 중 · 남은 시간 12분 means white rice is cooking, with 12 minutes left. [백미] 보온 중 3시간 means the rice has been kept warm for 3 hours.
예약 07:00 means the rice will be ready at 7:00. When the rice is done, many cookers say: 취사가 완료되었습니다. 밥을 잘 저어 주세요. 완료 means "done".

exercises: Look at the screen and answer in English: [현미] 취사 중 · 남은 시간 35분 — ① What kind of rice is it? ② How many minutes are left?
Which button or menu do you press? ① 시간이 없어요. 어떤 메뉴를 골라요? ② 앗, 물을 안 넣었어요! 밥솥을 멈추고 싶어요. ③ 지금은 오후 1시예요. 저녁 6시에 밥을 먹고 싶어요.
Fill in the blank with a button name: 밥이 다 됐어요. 저녁까지 밥을 따뜻하게 두고 싶어요. ____을 누르세요.
Put the steps in order: ㉠ 취사 버튼을 눌러요. ㉡ 쌀을 씻어요. ㉢ 밥을 잘 저어요. ㉣ 물을 넣어요.
Look at the screen [잡곡] 예약 18:30 and write Yes or No: ① 잡곡밥이에요. ② 밥이 18시 30분에 다 돼요. ③ 지금 보온 중이에요.
Answer in Korean with one word: 이가 아파요. 밥을 못 먹어요. 무슨 메뉴를 골라요?
answers: ① 쾌속 ② 취소 ③ 예약
① Yes ② Yes ③ No
